main.description: Generate (or regenerate) meeting minutes for a session from its transcriptSegment records. Default path is the deterministic extractive generator (hermetic, always available). The Murakumo LLM path (G4 Murakumo-only, LiteLLM loopback) is a refused-by-default membrane: it requires both the caller's allowLive flag and the operator gate. Caller must be onBehalfOfDid; the resulting meetingMinutes record is E2E-sealed with read-cap = onBehalfOfDid + recipients.

lang.description: BCP-47 hint for the generator output language.

allowLive.description: Request the Murakumo LLM path. Honored only when the operator gate is also on; otherwise the call is refused (no silent fallback).

recipients.description: Extra DIDs granted read-cap on the minutes (owner always included).
